create_IsolatedSubmodel: create an IsolatedSubmodel dataclass holding a submodel layer with its saved input and saved output for isolated analysis
build_IsolationCapturer: build an IsolationCapturer layer that wraps a target and captures its inputs, outputs, states, and random stream states
test_call_and_extract_submodel: test the call_and_extract_submodel function to isolate a selected sublayer from a larger model with captured activations and state
run_isolated_submodel: run an isolated submodel with its saved input to reproduce and compare its original output without running the full model
review_IsolatedSubmodel_attributes: review the IsolatedSubmodel class attributes submodel, saved_input, and saved_output for capturing intermediate activations of a subcomputation
